$comment: Golden oracle for money math (BR-005, BR-008, FR-072, FR-074, FR-075a, FR-081). ALL amounts are integer MINOR units (e.g. cents). Never use double/float. Two distinct mechanisms: (1) prize distribution across ranks, (2) team payout split among members.

rules.prizePool: prizePool = sum(paid entry fees) - organizerFee (BR-005, FR-072). Organizer fee is EITHER a percentage OR a fixed amount, never both (BR-006, FR-074).
rules.rankDistribution: share_i = round(prizePool * share_bp_i / 10000) using banker's rounding (round-half-to-even) to integer minor units. Then reconcile so sum(shares) == prizePool EXACTLY, one minor unit at a time: if the rounded sum is SHORT, add +1 walking from rank 1 downwards; if it EXCEEDS the pool, subtract 1 walking from the last rank upwards. Both directions are reachable — banker's rounding is unbiased, so it overshoots as often as it undershoots (tiers 5000/5000 with pool 3 round to 2+2=4). Walking one unit at a time rather than dumping the whole residual on one rank is a deliberate difference from teamSplit (BR-008).
rules.teamSplit: For teamSize > 1, split a Payout equally among members: base = floor(amount / teamSize) to every member; the remainder (amount - base*teamSize) goes ENTIRELY to the captain (FR-075a). For teamSize == 1, a single PayoutShare equals the whole amount.
invariants: sum(rank shares) == prizePool exactly, for a positive OR negative rounding residual
single currency per financial scope (BR-007, FR-080)
collapsing tied tiers happens before rounding (BR-008a)
rules.sharedRankDistribution: Competition ranks MAY be shared (single elimination: everyone knocked out in the same round shares a place). The pipeline is ORDERED and the steps do NOT commute (BR-008a): (1) COLLAPSE — for each group of participants sharing rank P, sum the share_bp of the places P..P+N-1 the group occupies (a place with no tier contributes 0 bp) into one synthetic tier; (2) ROUND the collapsed tier set per rankDistribution; (3) RECONCILE the residual over the collapsed set; (4) SPLIT within each group: floor(share / N) to every member, remainder to the LOWEST orderIndex. Rounding per tier BEFORE collapsing is wrong: it loses a minor unit on every tie with fractional raw shares and step 3 then hands that unit to rank 1, draining money out of tie groups to the winner. The tie-break PRNG therefore never decides money (DATA-MODEL.md §8.7, §9.4).

rankDistribution.name: Thirds of 100 -> residual to top rank
rankDistribution.$comment: Integer basis points cannot express 33.333333%; 3334/3333/3333 sums to exactly 10000 bp and yields the same shares.
rankDistribution.residualRule: +1 at a time from rank 1 downwards

rankDistribution.name: NEGATIVE residual -1: even split of an odd pool overshoots
rankDistribution.$comment: Both raw shares are 1.5 and half-to-even sends both to 2, totalling 4 > 3. One unit is removed from the LAST rank. Holds for every odd pool: 3, 7, 11, 15...
rankDistribution.residualRule: -1 at a time from the last rank upwards

rankDistribution.name: NEGATIVE residual -2: six-way even split of 100
rankDistribution.$comment: All six raw shares round up, totalling 102. Units are removed one at a time from the last rank upwards: ranks 6 and 5.
rankDistribution.residualRule: -1 at a time from the last rank upwards

rankDistribution.name: POSITIVE residual +2: four-way even split of 10
rankDistribution.$comment: All four raw shares are 2.5 and round down to 2, totalling 8. Units are added one at a time from rank 1 downwards: ranks 1 and 2 — NOT both to rank 1.
rankDistribution.residualRule: +1 at a time from rank 1 downwards

sharedRankDistribution.name: 8-player single elim, no third-place match: two share rank 3
sharedRankDistribution.$comment: Tiers exist for ranks 1-3 only; the tie group occupies places 3 and 4, and place 4 has no tier (0 bp).

sharedRankDistribution.name: Tie group spanning two paid tiers merges both shares
sharedRankDistribution.$comment: Tier 3 (1500 bp) and tier 4 (500 bp) are summed in step 1, BEFORE rounding. Residual 1 from banker's rounding then goes to rank 1.

sharedRankDistribution.name: Merge order is decisive: collapsing after rounding pays different people
sharedRankDistribution.$comment: THE discriminating case. Correct (collapse first): tier 3+4 = 2500 bp -> 25 exactly, residual 0, split 13/12.
